offers_products.reason: Smart safe hardware is offered but bundled into subscription services; the main offering is cash-in-transit and management services.

offers_services.reason: Armored cash transport, cash processing, ATM managed services and secure logistics for banks and retailers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are financial institutions, retailers, government agencies, mints and jewelers; no individual household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells cash management to banks, retailers, government agencies, mints and commercial businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscriptions and repeat scheduled cash pickups, processing and ATM service contracts with banks and retailers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cash handling, ATM servicing and secure transport are ongoing operational needs that customers rarely cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring subscription and per-pickup fees for cash collection and ATM services; small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value relies on armored fleets, vaults, smart safes and software networks, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers include financial institutions, large retailers, government agencies and mints, though small retailers are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Armored vehicle fleets, secure vaults and processing centers, ATMs and smart safes require heavy ongoing investment across many countries.
